How many weeks do you have left?

TimeLeft is not just a countdown timer; it is a philosophy. Inspired by Memento Mori and Stoicism, TimeLeft helps you visualize your life, year, and goals to build urgency, focus, and gratitude.

In a world full of distractions, it's easy to lose track of what matters. TimeLeft brings your focus back to the present moment by showing you exactly how much time you have remaining.

🚀 Key Features
Visualize Your Life: See your life as a grid of weeks. Watch the "lived" weeks fill up and grasp the finite nature of your time. Use it to gain perspective and prioritize what truly counts.

- Life Calendar: Track weeks lived vs. expected lifespan.
- Year Progress: Stay on top of your annual goals with a visual year tracker.
- Day Progress: See today passing by in hours
- Custom Goals: Set a deadline and watch the days count down.

🔥 FIRE Tracker (Financial Independence, Retire Early) Track your journey to financial freedom. Visualize your progress towards your target amount with beautiful charts and percentages.

- "Building the foundation" to "Freedom is within reach."
- See exactly how much you have left to save.

🎨 Stunning Live Wallpapers Keep your goals front and center without opening an app. TimeLeft offers a suite of beautiful, battery-efficient live wallpapers that turn your home screen into a productivity dashboard.

- Grid Matrix: The classic Memento Mori dot grid.
- Circular & Arc: Sleek, modern rings and semi-circles.
- Progress Bars: Minimalist and effective.
- Calendar & Blocks: Structured views for analytical minds.

✨ Premium Customization Make it yours with advanced styling options.
- Colour Palettes: Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Minimal, and more.
- Framing: Choose to see what you've "Lived" or what's "Remaining."
- Shapes: Circles, Squares, Rounded corners.

🔒 100% Private & Offline. Your life is your business. TimeLeft works completely offline.

- No Accounts Needed: Just download and start.
- No Tracking: We don't collect any personal data.
- Zero Ads: A distraction-free experience.

Pro Features:
- Auto-rotate between multiple trackers
- More control over colors
- Save your settings as presets

Note: When you restart your device, the live wallpaper will become active only after first unlocking the phone and will continue to work fine after that. No steps required.

Why TimeLeft?
- Beat Procrastination: Visualizing the deadline makes you act.
- Stoic Wisdom: Embrace the reality of time to live a fuller life.
- Stay Focused: Your goals are always visible on your wallpaper.

Don't waste time. See your life in weeks, days, and percentages on Lock Screen
